name: agents
title: Agents
description: Operation-based staff chat with saved conversations, attachments and per-action approvals.

files.content:
export const agentsLabels = {
  title: "Agents",
  settings: "Settings",
  externalAssistant: "External assistant",
  modelSettings: "Model settings",
  modelSettingsRestricted:
    "Only administrators can configure the shared AI model. Ask an administrator to change it.",
  settingsDescription:
    "Choose the AI provider and model for this website. Saved changes apply to the next chat request for all staff.",
  provider: "Provider",
  apiKey: "API key",
  keyHelp: "Enter your provider’s API key. It is saved securely on the server.",
  savedKey: "An API key is saved. Leave this blank to keep it, or enter a replacement.",
  showKey: "Show API key",
  hideKey: "Hide API key",
  loadModels: "Load models",
  model: "Model",
  chooseModel: "Select a model",
  modelHelp:
    "Choose a text model that supports tool calling. Availability and usage charges depend on your provider account.",
  noModels: "No models are available for this key. Check your provider account and try again.",
  save: "Save",
  settingsSaved: "Model settings saved. The next chat request will use this connection.",
  settingsNotConfigured:
    "AI model setup is incomplete on the server. Contact the person who manages this website’s hosting.",
  settingsLoadError: "Settings could not be loaded. Close and reopen Settings to retry.",
  settingsError:
    "Could not connect. Check your key, model and provider access, then retry. Saved settings are unchanged.",
  disconnect: "Disconnect",
  confirmDisconnect: "Confirm disconnect",
  disconnectDescription:
    "Disconnect this website’s AI model? Staff will need a new connection to continue chatting. Saved conversations remain.",
  disconnected: "Model disconnected. Saved conversations are unchanged.",
  modelNotConfigured:
    "No AI model is connected. Ask a website administrator to configure it in Settings.",
  operation: "Operation",
  chooseOperation: "Select an operation",
  chooseFirst: "Select an operation to start.",
  conversations: "Conversations",
  privateConversations: "Private conversations",
  today: "Today",
  yesterday: "Yesterday",
  earlier: "Earlier",
  allOperations: "All operations",
  conversation: "Conversation",
  newConversation: "New conversation",
  untitled: "Untitled conversation",
  emptyHistory: "No conversations yet.",
  start: "Start a conversation",
  emptyChat: "What would you like to work on?",
  message: "Message",
  placeholder: "Describe your task…",
  send: "Send",
  keyboardHelp: "Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line",
  stop: "Stop",
  retry: "Retry",
  resume: "Continue",
  loading: "Loading…",
  thinking: "Responding…",
  close: "Close",
  attach: "Attach file",
  attachments: "Attachments",
  imageUse: "Image use",
  removeAttachment: "Remove attachment",
  attachmentFailed: "The file could not be uploaded. Retry or choose another file.",
  you: "You",
  assistant: "Agent",
  tool: "Operation result",
  approve: "Approve",
  reject: "Reject",
  before: "Before",
  after: "After",
  effects: "Effects",
  pending: "Awaiting approval",
  executing: "Applying change…",
  succeeded: "Completed",
  rejected: "Rejected",
  stale: "Proposal expired. Continue to prepare a new one.",
  unresolved:
    "The outcome is unknown. Check the plugin and ask your administrator to reconcile it before continuing.",
  updated: "Action completed",
  deleteConversation: "Delete conversation",
  deleteTitle: "Delete this conversation?",
  deleteDescription:
    "Its messages and chat attachments will be deleted. Changes already made in other plugins remain.",
  cancel: "Cancel",
  confirmDelete: "Delete",
  result: "View result",
  openRecord: "Open record",
  download: "Download",
  fileUnavailable: "The attachment could not be loaded.",
  unavailable: "This operation or conversation is unavailable.",
  error: "The request failed. Your message is saved; retry when ready.",
  busy: "This conversation is busy. Refresh before continuing.",
  pendingError: "Approve or reject the pending action first.",
  limit: "This request is too large. Use fewer files or a smaller task.",
  invalid: "Check the request and try again.",
  storage: "File storage is unavailable. Retry when it is available.",
  refresh: "Refresh",
  noOperations: "No operations are available for your account.",
};
export type AgentsLabels = Omit<typeof agentsLabels, "conversation"> & { conversation?: string };

import {
  BotMessageSquareIcon,
  CircleHelpIcon,
